description: t.o races two members that return at once; both are ready when t.o next polls, so Rust's race_all picks newly_ready[cx.random_usize(2)] from t.o's entropy (cx/scope.rs:1340-1365): t.o's DetEntropy is forked from the runtime source with its task-arena id and the runtime's fork counter (util/entropy.rs fork, state.rs:4356), and with seed 10 the draw picks member 1. C picked the lowest index; it now draws from the same per-task stream under lab dispatch (bd-g652).
